project_name: GNN4GC (Graph Neural Networks for Grid Control)
project_description: A project funded by the German Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Protection, in which TenneT Germany works with 50Hertz, Kassel University and Fraunhofer IEE until end-2026. It develops graph neural network models and agents for AC load flows and topological actions, and early results using TenneT data look promising.
